runners_data.name: Me Tarzan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should track Mr Ubiquitous comfortably but may lack the class edge to get past the principals

runners_data.name: Diamont Katie
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning quickly from an impressive Pontefract win with wind operation clearly helping her breathing
runners_data.comment: Back from a wind operation when winning comfortably last week at Pontefract; penalised
runners_data.spotlight: Back from a wind operation when winning comfortably last week at Pontefract (6f, good); carries a penalty but should be hard to beat if as good again, as returning to 7f won't hinder her at all.

runners_data.name: Noble Guest
runners_data.note: Classy prominent runner returning from a long break which could either hinder fitness or aid freshness under George Margarson

runners_data.name: Way To Dubai
runners_data.note: Aging hold-up horse whose best days appear behind him but the 5lb weight advantage gives him a fighting chance

runners_data.name: Mr Ubiquitous
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who gets the perfect tactical setup to control the race from pillar to post

runners_data.name: Dancing Terror
runners_data.note: Deep hold-up horse returning from Amanda Perrett's small string after a disappointing last run at this course

races.paceDynamic: Mr Ubiquitous will be the dominant pace-setter from the gates with his prominent style, likely getting an uncontested lead given the lack of other confirmed front runners. Me Tarzan and Noble Guest may press from prominent positions early but both have shown they can settle, while Diamont Katie, Way To Dubai and Dancing Terror will need to be produced from off the pace. The single pace angle creates a tactical race where Mr Ubiquitous controls the tempo completely. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can track the pace, as the hold-up horses face the difficult task of making up ground against a horse that can dictate fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ubiquitous Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Ubiquitous gets his preferred steady fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: He dictates a sustainable pace that suits his stamina reserves and kicks clear in the final furlong when the hold-up horses have too much to do. The prominent runners Me Tarzan and Noble Guest benefit from tracking the pace but can't match his finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Me Tarzan or Noble Guest press Mr Ubiquitous from the start creating faster fractions
scenarios.body: The increased pace compromises Mr Ubiquitous's stamina advantage and sets up the race for the hold-up horses to close strongly. Diamont Katie's proven finishing speed becomes the decisive factor in a fast-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Noble Guest Comeback Special
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Guest shows his best form after the 189-day break and travels strongly throughout
scenarios.body: His class advantage tells as he produces his peak 7f form to outgun the field in the closing stages. The long absence proves beneficial rather than detrimental with George Margarson having him spot-on for return.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Dancing Terror Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: His hold-up style proves perfect for a slowly-run tactical affair where raw finishing speed matters most. Amanda Perrett's horse finds the improvement needed to capitalize on a gift pace scenario.

watchPoints.text: Mr Ubiquitous's early fractions will determine the entire race outcome - if he goes too fast early he becomes vulnerable
Noble Guest's fitness after 189 days off the track is the major unknown factor that could upset all calculations
Diamont Katie's penalty for last week's win may not be enough to stop her if the pace sets up right for closers
Me Tarzan's ability to lay up close enough to Mr Ubiquitous without getting into an early speed duel
Way To Dubai needs a genuine strong pace to be competitive given his advancing years and recent moderate form

runners_data.name: Nevasca Cinza

runners_data.name: Firewalker

runners_data.comment: Beaten at 1-4 on debut; cut out quickly when again prominent in the betting at Doncaster
runners_data.spotlight: Cost 360,000gns as a foal; beaten at 1-4 on debut and cut out quickly when again prominent in the betting at Doncaster (7f) one month ago; held a 2,000 Guineas entry that day but not now; may step up but has to.

runners_data.name: Creative Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist from powerful stable, relies on strong early pace to be effective from rear position

runners_data.name: Unique Procedure
runners_data.note: Exposed maiden with limited ability, Dylan Hogan booking suggests stable confidence but form is poor

runners_data.name: Shining Guest
runners_data.note: Long absence is major concern despite Marco Ghiani taking the ride, needs everything to fall right

runners_data.name: Izzy Fast
runners_data.note: Four-year-old maiden carrying penalty weight, Silvestre De Sousa booking is positive but form trend is downward

races.paceDynamic: Nevasca Cinza and Firewalker will engage from the gates in this small field, with Nevasca Cinza showing more consistent early pace on recent form. Shining Guest may press from a prominent position but lacks recent action, leaving the two leaders to set a solid tempo over this sharp 6f trip. The small field and dual pace angle suggests a sustained gallop rather than stop-start fractions. This race shape favours horses with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as the likely honest tempo will stretch the field and expose pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Nevasca Cinza Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Nevasca Cinza breaks cleanly and dictates terms from the front
scenarios.body: The consistent front-runner gets first run on proven form and holds off late challenges in a race that suits her forward-going style. Her recent placings at this trip on similar ground give her the tactical edge over less proven rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Firewalker Bounces Back
scenarios.trigger: If Firewalker shows his expensive breeding and settles better than at Doncaster
scenarios.body: The 360,000gns purchase finds his level against maidens after failing to handle a stronger pace last time. David Egan can use his natural speed to control the race and kick clear in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Creative Queen Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong between the two leaders
scenarios.body: William Haggas' filly gets the perfect setup from her hold-up style as Nevasca Cinza and Firewalker soften each other up. Cieren Fallon times his run to perfection as the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If neither leader shows early gate speed or one takes a backward step
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no genuine pace, allowing the outsiders to stay competitive longer. The lack of early pressure means stamina and finishing kick become more important than pure speed.

watchPoints.text: Firewalker's early positioning - if he breaks slowly again like at Doncaster his chance is immediately compromised
Creative Queen needs genuine early pace between the leaders to set up her late run effectively
Nevasca Cinza's gate speed will determine if she can control from the front or gets headed early
Shining Guest showing any early zip after 277 days off would indicate serious stable confidence
The gap between front two and the field after two furlongs will reveal if this becomes a two-horse race

races.paceDynamic: Sea Mehalah Run will be the sole pace-setter from the gates, establishing a comfortable rhythm through the early stages without pressure from the field of hold-up horses behind. Lucky Sevens showed front-running ability when winning here last week but is more prominent than lead, while the remaining nine runners all prefer to come from off the pace. This creates a scenario where Sea Mehalah Run dictates terms through moderate fractions before the inevitable cavalry charge in the final three furlongs. The lack of pace pressure strongly favors hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as they'll get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Mehalah Run sets honest but undemanding fractions and fades as usual in the finish.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the ideal tactical setup with plenty of pace to aim at in the closing stages. Strong finishers like Lucky Sevens, Montu and Private Project can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Mehalah Run finds improved stamina after the 152-day break and sustains his effort.
scenarios.body: Despite his history of fading, the uncontested lead allows him to dictate ideal fractions and hold on from the closers. The long absence could have benefited his stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Mehalah Run goes too slowly early and creates a sprint finish scenario.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl before exploding into a dash, suiting horses with the best turn of foot rather than sustained stamina. This radical tempo change could shake up the form book entirely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Lucky Sevens or another runner challenges Sea Mehalah Run for the early lead.
scenarios.body: The unexpected pace battle creates faster fractions that could collapse both early leaders and set up the race for the most patient hold-up horses. This scenario least likely given the field composition.

watchPoints.text: Sea Mehalah Run's early tempo will dictate the entire race shape - if he goes too fast or too slow it changes everything.
Lucky Sevens could challenge early rather than sit behind, which would create unexpected pace pressure and benefit the patient hold-up horses more.
Private Project and Montu both prefer hold-up tactics - watch for traffic problems in the straight with so many similar running styles.
The going has been called Good to Firm consistently across the card, potentially favoring horses with proven form on faster surfaces.
Several runners return from long breaks including Fletcher (228d) and Karios (186d) - watch for market support indicating readiness.

runners_data.name: Sword Of Wessex
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with class edge but hasn't won for some time and his front-running tag may be misleading given recent hold-up style

runners_data.name: One Million Dreams
runners_data.note: Fresh from 32-day break with winning form last time, hold-up style suits but inexperienced claimer takes over

runners_data.name: Pershalla
runners_data.note: Won last time at Kempton over similar trip in hood, showing improved form and tactical awareness under pressure
runners_data.comment: Back up 4lb for the AW Kempton win but in form and probably capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced for a 4yo; seemingly all the better for her comeback run, and the fitting of a hood, when finding the most to lead near the line at Kempton (1m4f, AW) 20 days ago; back up 4lb but in form and probably capable of better.

runners_data.name: Atlantic Sunset
runners_data.note: Long absence of 83 days is concerning and recent form figures suggest decline, though blinkers applied

races.paceDynamic: Sword Of Wessex is the sole confirmed front runner in this small field, but his hold-up style suggests he may not lead from the off, creating a potential pace vacuum early. With all four runners showing hold-up tendencies, the early gallop could be sedate until someone forces the issue. One Million Dreams and Pershalla both have recent winning form and may be willing to press forward if the pace becomes crawling. This shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can quicken from off the pace, rather than pure hold-up horses who need a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Quickens Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and quickens from halfway
scenarios.body: The tactical speed horses can position perfectly and deliver their finishing kicks to best effect. One Million Dreams and Pershalla, both recent winners, are best equipped for this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running early creating a slow gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the turn with pure finishing speed paramount. Pershalla's recent Kempton win in similar circumstances makes her dangerous.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sword Of Wessex Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Sword Of Wessex abandons hold-up tactics and makes running from the start
scenarios.body: His class edge could prove decisive if he gets an uncontested lead on the front end. The others may struggle to peg back a loose leader over this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses go forward early creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true test of stamina over this extended trip. Atlantic Sunset's poor recent form makes him vulnerable despite the strong pace suiting hold-up horses.

watchPoints.text: One Million Dreams carrying a 7lb claiming rider who may struggle with tactical decisions in a slowly-run race
Pershalla's hood fitting has transformed her but she needs to reproduce Kempton form on turf after all-weather success
Sword Of Wessex's actual running position early will reveal whether he truly leads or tracks as recent form suggests
Atlantic Sunset's 83-day layoff combined with poor recent form makes fitness a major question mark

runners_data.name: Miss Nightfall
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from a month off, needs a strong pace to be effective but has solid course form.

runners_data.name: Lady Manzor
runners_data.note: Claimer aboard this hold-up filly drops her to a handy weight but she needs everything to fall right.

runners_data.name: Bridget's View
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type who has shown some consistency but faces a tactical disadvantage in this small field.

runners_data.name: Lady Mariko
runners_data.note: In-form closer who won last time and represents the best hope of the hold-up brigade if pace develops.

runners_data.name: Ironist
runners_data.note: Stepped up in trip after recent course success, prominent style gives her tactical advantage but this looks tougher.
runners_data.comment: Ran okay last week after her break but this is much tougher than usual
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner last September over 6f on soft ground when 3lb lower; ran okay after her break last week but this is much tougher than usual.

runners_data.name: Shallow
runners_data.note: Natural leader with proven course form, perfectly positioned to exploit the lack of early pace pressure.

races.paceDynamic: Shallow will take the field along from the front with only Ironist and Havana Pusey likely to race prominently early, creating a sustainable pace scenario. The majority of the field (Miss Nightfall, Lady Manzor, Bridget's View, Lady Mariko) are hold-up types who will need the race to develop. With limited early pace pressure on Shallow, she can dictate terms and potentially steal a march on the closers. This race shape strongly favours the early pace, particularly Shallow who can control the tempo, and prominent racers who can track without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shallow Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Shallow gets an uncontested lead and dictates a modest pace
scenarios.body: She can kick clear in the straight before the hold-up horses get organized, with any prominent tracker like Havana Pusey able to follow her move. The lack of early pressure allows the leaders to save energy for a decisive strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Kick Required
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred setup but need to find significant improvement to reel in the early leaders. Lady Mariko's recent winning form gives her the best chance of the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Pusey or Ironist can sit close enough to Shallow without racing keenly
scenarios.body: They can utilize their class advantage when Shallow comes under pressure, timing their move to perfection in the final furlong. The pace becomes optimal for horses racing just behind the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Shallow goes too slow early and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: It becomes a sprint finish where the best horse on the day wins regardless of tactics. The higher-rated fillies can assert their class in a scramble.

watchPoints.text: Shallow getting an easy lead through the first half-mile will make her very difficult to peg back
Havana Pusey racing too keenly if she tries to press Shallow early, which would compromise her finishing kick
Lady Mariko's position turning for home, as she'll need to be closer than usual given the likely modest pace
The overall tempo through the middle furlong - if it's too steady the closers are in trouble
Ironist handling the step up in trip, as her recent form has been over shorter distances

runners_data.name: Edergole's Gift
runners_data.note: Patient type from deep but topweight burden and claiming rider makes task considerably harder
runners_data.comment: Since going close on the AW in January she's lost her way; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Only 3-35 so hard to win with and since going close on the AW in January she's lost her way; others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Dion Baker and Top Biller will clash from the gates with both horses committed front-runners who set honest gallops. With only two natural leaders in a nine-runner field, they'll establish a solid tempo without being suicidal, creating an even-paced race rather than stop-start fractions. The modest early pace will compress the field turning for home, setting up a scramble in the final two furlongs. This shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can pick off tired leaders, with the patient tactics getting the better of the early speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Dion Baker and Top Biller go steady early fractions
scenarios.body: The pace will be just honest enough to string out the field but not fast enough to stop closers, allowing the back markers to unleash late runs. Moonhall Lass, Griselda, and Chiedozie can all finish strongly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front pair collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too fast trying to shake each other off
scenarios.body: Dion Baker and Top Biller will weaken dramatically in the final furlong after an overly competitive early duel. This opens the door for prominent racers like Grand Citadel and Sir Rodneyredblood to sweep past the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: One leader dominates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Top Biller gets an uncontested lead with Dion Baker settling behind
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a tactical affair with a slow tempo that doesn't play to the closers' strengths. Top Biller can dictate terms from the front and prove too strong in the closing stages with energy preserved.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy scramble finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race will turn into a sprint finish where track position and racing luck become crucial factors. Any horse drawn well and getting a clear run can win regardless of running style in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch Dion Baker and Top Biller clash early - if they go too fast they'll both stop dramatically
Monitor Griselda's position turning in - she's been fading late and needs everything to fall right
Check Moonhall Lass gets clear running room in straight as she'll need space to unleash finishing kick
Watch for Grand Citadel to get prominent position early as she needs to be handy to strike
Observe No Gain's position at halfway - Cosgrave will want him settled but not too far back

races.paceDynamic: Takincareofbizness will lead from the start with minimal early pressure, as Sea Her Excel and Saeculamation are the only prominent runners likely to track close. The majority of the field (Sweet Echo, Zoustar Dreams, Go Lockers Go, Blueaway) prefer to come from behind, creating a bunched hold-up group settling in rear. With just one confirmed leader and light early pressure, Takincareofbizness can dictate a measured gallop before the field closes late. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without duelling early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Takincareofbizness maintains a steady tempo without serious early challenge
scenarios.body: The gelding can build a crucial advantage before the hold-up horses mount their challenge, with Sea Her Excel tracking prominently to strike late. The lack of pace pressure allows the front two to dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Her Excel and Saeculamation both track Takincareofbizness closely from the start
scenarios.body: The three-horse leading group creates genuine pace that suits the prominent runners perfectly, allowing them to kick clear of the hold-up brigade. Superior positioning trumps raw ability in this sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes pedestrian throughout
scenarios.body: Zoustar Dreams and Go Lockers Go can overcome their poor positioning as the race becomes a pure sprint from the furlong pole. The class horses assert late despite giving the leaders a significant start.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Takincareofbizness goes very slowly and the field remains tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where any horse can win from any position, favouring those drawn well or with the strongest finishing kick. Positioning becomes irrelevant in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Takincareofbizness dictates the gallop completely as the only natural leader with no early pressure expected
Sea Her Excel's positioning behind the leader as De Sousa rarely gets tactics wrong in small fields
Go Lockers Go's early behaviour since he can take strong hold which would compromise his hold-up style
Sweet Echo's condition after 150 days off as fitness could be crucial in this competitive sprint
The overall pace development as a slow gallop would completely change the complexion of this race
